messages:
Elaine (AE): HelixPay asked for one ZIP with: BOM + sizing, per-hour POC cost, filled security questionnaire, signed NDA link, SOW template, and short capability matrix. EOD tomorrow. Can we assemble?
Sam (Solutions Eng): Yep. Target perf they specified: 150 embeddings/s sustained, p99 embed <200ms, p95 gen <=1.2s at 2k tokens. I'll run quick microbench tomorrow AM.
Priya (Solutions): I'll draft BOM (dedicated vs reserve+burst) and a pre-filled cost sheet using 2k tokens/session, 500 sessions/day, 40% cache hit.
Sam (Solutions Eng): ops-bot, please provision helixpay-test cluster: 3xA100 us-east-1 for 2h.
ops-bot: Ticket INC-9017 created, ETA ~10m.
Jordan (Legal): I'll prep NDA link and SOW template. Note: remove broad indemnity for eval and add data-deletion appendix.
Priya (Solutions): Security Q filled; flagged 9 Qs for legal/infrastructure (HSM custody, cross-region replication, retention). Need KMS/HSM blurb.
Jordan (Legal): KMS/HSM: support CMK via AWS/GCP/Azure; Private option supports on-prem HSMs (provisioning lead time noted). I'll attach kms-statement.txt.
Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll include reproducible commands and a small perf snapshot. Add tech note: routing prefers pinned -> quantized replica -> hosted fallback; all fallbacks logged with tracing id.
Priya (Solutions): Files to ZIP: [bom-dedicated-vs-burst.csv, poc-cost-calculator.xlsx (filled), security-answers-flagged.pdf, redacted-network-diagram.png, kms-statement.txt, nda-link.txt, poc-sow-template.docx, perf-runbook.md, perf-results.csv].
Elaine (AE): Timeline: Priya+Sam finish by 15:00, Jordan provides legal by 17:00, I assemble and upload to Sales Drive by 18:30, send to buyer tomorrow AM. DM me if blocked. :rocket:
